name: Call of Earth
summary: At Spirit Rock, Canaga Earthcaller guides young shaman through their first communion with the elements. They drink an Earth Sapta on sacred ground to see the Minor Manifestation of Earth.

sections.title: The Power of the Sapta
sections.body: A sapta is a mystical draught known to only a few shaman masters. Made with elemental magic, it bridges mortal perception and the spiritual plane, granting Sapta Sight to the strong-willed. Because it binds the drinker's spirit directly to an element, tradition forbids drinking it outside consecrated holy ground.

sections.title: Pilgrimage to Spirit Rock
sections.body: To commune with earth, you leave the Valley of Trials and climb the Hidden Path into Durotar's southern crags. Spirit Rock waits at the trail's end, an elevated sanctuary overlooking the rugged wasteland. Drink the sapta there, and you can perceive what ordinary eyes cannot: an elemental presence among the stone.

sections.title: Patience of the Earth
sections.body: The Minor Manifestation of Earth asks no bloodshed or submission. It asks only that you stand humbly before the world. Fire, water, and air bear turbulent, volatile, often chaotic spirits, while earth teaches steadiness. Mountains offer endurance, and plains teach boundless patience.

faq.answer: An Earth Sapta is a potion brewed by veteran shaman to attune a drinker's spirit temporarily to earth. Drinking it grants the inner sight needed to see and speak with hidden elemental spirits.
Spirit Rock lies in the craggy mountains southwest of the Den in the Valley of Trials. Follow the Hidden Path into the hills south of the valley floor to reach it.

faq.q: Why must the sapta be consumed at Spirit Rock?
faq.answer: Shamanic tradition permits drinking a sapta only in a designated holy place. Sacred sites like Spirit Rock are natural thin places between the mortal realm and elemental spirits.

faq.q: Who is the Minor Manifestation of Earth?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Earth is an elemental spirit dwelling at Spirit Rock. Only Sapta Sight's heightened perception can reveal it; the spirit greets young shaman to test their humility and teach the first lessons of elemental balance.

faq.q: Can any Horde shaman undertake this trial?
aliases: who can do call of earth
faq.answer: Young orc and Darkspear troll shaman training in Durotar chiefly undertake this rite. Tauren shaman who travel here may also complete it, though their equivalent rite takes place on Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: How does the earth spirit react to the initiate?
aliases: what does the earth spirit say
faq.answer: Unlike the volatile manifestations of fire or air, the earth spirit welcomes and accepts initiates who approach with humble respect. It bestows its blessing without demanding a contest of strength.

angles.text: As a shaman, you take your first step toward attunement with the elements. True mastery begins with earth's quiet patience.
For orcs returning to ancestral ways after generations of fel corruption, communion through the Earth Sapta is a sacred rediscovery of their people's traditional bond with the spirits.
As a Darkspear troll, you embrace these earthen rites to adapt your deep ancestral ties to Durotar's harsh, sun-baked landscape.
